corrections: Fixed-base losses total 9%; adding 18% totals 27%, not exactly one third.
The second stake offsets the first loss only at net payout of at least 50%, before costs; the third offsets the first two under the same threshold. A win alone does not guarantee compensation.
Stopping for the day conflicts with returning that evening to recover losses. A pause does not restore funds or reset the chosen daily limit; a bot cannot supersede it.
Universal claims about inability to remain calm and inevitable loss of the remainder are unsupported.
